imagegen_prompt:
Create exactly one photorealistic vertical photograph from this locked brief. All depicted people are adults. Preserve the described cause, visible response, and consequence in one frame; do not replace them with a generic beauty pose.

POSITIVE PROMPT
Vertical documentary medium-close photograph inside a real security control room. One explicitly adult original security guard stands at a badge counter in a covered professional uniform, with radio, ID lanyard, and surveillance monitors kept peripheral. Her baseline is exact stoic control: visitor badges form perfectly aligned rows, her shoulders are square, and her expression is unreadably professional. One visitor badge flips upside down when its clip catches on her radio cord. The inverted visitor badge at the front of the aligned row is fully visible. Her eyes widen for one beat, her lips part in a tiny caught breath, her shoulders jump, and one hand shields the badge as if nobody noticed. Her other hand rotates it upright, but a small crooked gap remains in the otherwise perfect row. Her adult security-guard identity, practical uniform, ID lanyard, and control-room context remain readable. Her face, shielding hand, correcting fingers, radio cord, and inverted badge share one tight focal plane. Eye-level 35mm documentary camera, cool fluorescent room light mixed with monitor bounce, fine grain, creased fabric, contact shadows, and shallow background falloff. Nonsexual, gentle observational comedy without humiliation.

3D render look, duplicate faces, low resolution, broken facial features, awkward expression, over-processed retouching, cropped-off head, excessive HDR, plastic-looking skin, unrealistic hands, illustration look, body distortion, diagram layout, infographic, flowchart, dashboard layout, presentation slide deck, floating UI panels, callout labels, chart axes and legend, wireframe mockup, icon grid, blueprint sheet as the main subject, screen-only frontal close-up, readable long screen text, HUD overlay, monitor graphics as the main subject
